cards.need: It holds the only digital copy of my grandmother's legendary spicy stew recipe.
cards.stakes: The food critic arrives tonight and I'll be ruined if I serve them my backup menu.
cards.board_text: Disaster! My sous-chef accidentally locked the family recipe index into a high-security core and forgot the passphrase. I need a replacement core to brute-force the decryption! The most famous food blogger in the quadrant is coming for dinner and I will not be humiliated!

cards.need: Our atmospheric scrubbers failed, and these engineered crops are the only way to re-oxygenate the station.
cards.stakes: The entire population will choke to death on carbon dioxide within a week.
cards.board_text: Red alert on Station 4. The scrubbers are dead, and our air is getting thinner by the hour. We need a hydroponic seed vault loaded with fast-growing algae and oxygenators. Bring them now, or you'll be delivering to a tomb.

cards.need: It contains my perfectly preserved audition tape for the latest holodrama.
cards.stakes: If the director doesn't receive it by casting call, my rival will get the lead role of 'Space Detective'.
cards.board_text: Tragedy! The courier lost my audition package! I need a sealed evidence tube to perfectly preserve a backup copy of my emotional monologue. It must be pristine! If that hack gets the part over me, I shall perish of pure artistic despair!

cards.need: It contains the final piece of evidence from my one unsolved case, decades old.
cards.stakes: I just want to finally know who killed my partner before my memory fades completely.
cards.board_text: Thirty years I've stared at this case file. I finally tracked down the missing physical evidence, but I need a clean tube to secure it before the local atmosphere degrades the traces. Just help an old cop close the book. It's the only thing keeping me awake at night.
